originalEntry.prompt: make a dynamic 16:9 aspect ratio 90-second motion graphics video that shows exactly what an incredible motion designer you are and your true creative limits, like it's your showreel for a résumé. use s tier sound design, no synth. go all out. compose your own original and viral piano score. export it as a 1080p mp4 for social media.
originalEntry.prompt_zh: 制作一段 16:9 画幅、90 秒的动态图形视频，准确展示你是多么出色的动效设计师，以及你真正的创意极限，就像简历里的作品集一样。用 S 级的声音设计，不要合成器。拿出全部本事。自己创作一首原创、有传播力的钢琴配乐。导出为适合社交媒体的 1080p mp4。
